findings: Quick mode skipped all ten targets because no vendor profile matched. No native candidate was validated.
Normal mode finished seven per-target 60-second budgets; target eight was manually cancelled. Targets nine and ten were not tested.
Four timed targets logged association/EAPOL start but no identity request or M1. One target could not associate.
Targets four and six logged identity, M1, M3 and NACK and advanced the last candidate beyond 00000000. Target four reported rate limiting/lock.
Upstream v1.6.5/v1.6.6 define 0x02 as RX_TIMEOUT, distinct from KEY_REJECTED. Missing log events cannot identify the cause of over-air loss.
Kernel source-address and channel readbacks passed for each started target. This does not certify every driver or target interaction.
changes: Default and current saved attack_seconds are zero. Zero uses an infinite deadline; positive values retain their previous budgets.
Unlimited WPS reuses the PID-identity lease watchdog and renews under supervision. No fixed total-runtime watchdog is installed. Lost-controller, workspace and log-size protection remain active.
Elapsed seconds, candidate updates, periodic checkpoints, cancellation, success and precise process cleanup remain active. Zero progress total means indeterminate.
Zero disables rounds and executes one continuous native process. Quick mode keeps its independent 15-second budget.
Diagnostic descriptions translate receive timeout and watchdog stop reasons.
